lines: Williams is getting 14.3 carries per game over his last 3 games, but his targets dropped to 3.3 per game from 5.1 on the season.
He scored 9.1 PPR points per game over his last 3 games, well under his 16.4 season average.
Week 12 is against GB, which allows the 7th-most PPR points per game to RBs. The coach said Williams is limited with a toe issue.
